code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/System/{list/ParameterList,form/ParameterForm}.tsx + App.tsx route /system/parameter; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/parameter/ParameterController (+OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor, OCMS_SYSTEM_PARAMETER); ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{helpers/ToppanUploadHelper,jobs/ToppanUploadJob,models/ToppanStage}, framework/schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler, framework/controllers/ToppanUnifiedController, furnish_processing/helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper, notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsTemplateStore/OcmsTemplateStoreServiceImpl. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui: no related code
note: Story status: Fully paid. Requirement text is given. Letter reminder post-dating is stored as parameter POS per stage in ocms_parameter and can be changed through the generic Parameter page (there is no dedicated Post Dated page). The letter date calculation is in the Toppan upload (processingDate + POS, default 14), but the base is the job run time, daily letter generation only runs through a manual trigger (the scheduler call is commented out), and the prod properties block Toppan upload (sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan); the real server value cannot be verified from repo. Court summonses have no printing or POS parameter in any repo. POS rows in the DB: cannot verify from repo. Tickets used: OCMS-DF-2026-180 (POS still used at reminder stages, not for eNA) and OCMS-SR-2026-039 (Parameter edit hardening: patch only description/value, HTML-escape).
recommendation: Claim partially: POS configuration through the Parameter page works and the letter date formula exists for reminder and demand letters. Court summons has no code. Confirm with URA that a date base of the generation date is acceptable and that manual letter generation and the disabled Toppan upload in prod are accepted

steps.step: Officer opens a System Admin configuration page to set the post-dating of letter reminders and court summonses
steps.detail: There is no dedicated post-dating page: POST_DATING in System.ts:65 has a null path, and LETTER_REMINDER has the path /system/letter-reminder (System.ts:49) but no Route; App.tsx:375-500 only registers parameter, standardcode, computer-rule-code, suspension-reason, schedule-public-holiday. What can be used is the generic Parameter page (/system/parameter, App.tsx:377-399), which lists all ocms_parameter rows through POST /parameterlist (ParameterList.tsx:137-152, ParameterController.java:81-88). Authorization function OCMS_SYSTEM_PARAMETER (api-authorization.properties:166-167) is enforced on the server by OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor (OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor.java:57-74).

steps.step: Officer changes the number of post-dating days (X days) per letter type
steps.detail: Edit calls POST /parameterpatch/{parameterId}/{code} (ParameterForm.tsx:72-82) with parameterId POS and code = stage (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), the same key the reader uses in ToppanUploadHelper.java:197. The controller only allows description and value (ParameterController.java:90-107) and HTML-escapes them (comment OCMS-DEV-2026-039, ticket OCMS-SR-2026-039). A new row can be created through POST /parameter (ParameterController.java:48-76). Note: validation is only 'required' (ValidParameter.ts:46); a non-numeric value is accepted and silently falls back to the 14-day default (ToppanUploadHelper.java:199-207). Whether the POS rows per stage exist in the DB: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The reminder letter date is calculated as X days from the date the file is interfaced to the printing vendor
steps.detail: The formula exists: calculateLetterDate = processingDate + parameter POS per stage, default 14 (ToppanUploadHelper.java:196-208), called at ToppanUploadHelper.java:2060 for RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3 (ToppanStage.java:19-24); ANL letters do not use POS, their date = the run date (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2612). But the base date is LocalDateTime.now() when the job runs (ToppanUploadJob.java:232,248), not the time the file is actually sent to the vendor. Daily letter generation is also not automatic: the call toppanLettersGeneratorService.executeJob() in the scheduler is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118) and only the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters runs it (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34-40). In application-prod.properties:86 sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan, so upload to Toppan is blocked; the real server value cannot be verified from repo. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 (closed, prod deployed) confirms POS is still used for the payment due date at reminder stages.

steps.step: Post-dating also applies to court summonses
steps.detail: The stages Toppan prints are only RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3 and ANL (ToppanStage.java:19-25); there is no court summons generator and no POS parameter for a court stage. COS (Court Summons) only appears as a stage code in the AXS payment flag (AxsNopoServiceImpl.java:795) and CPC only as a fallback next stage (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1815-1819). A search for synonyms (summons, summon, court letter) in the six repos found no summons printing. It may be printed by another system (State Courts/CAS): cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: A changed value applies on the next run without a code change
steps.detail: getParameterValue calls parameterRepository.findById every time it is used, with no cache (ToppanUploadHelper.java:177-188), so a changed POS value is read on the next run without a deploy. The same POS value also drives the payment due date in furnish approval (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:817-821), the template preview (OcmsTemplateStoreServiceImpl.java:238-243) and the reminder SMS/email query (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1103-1106). The effect on real letters depends on step 3.
